title: Consolidation: Concession & Evaluation in Speech
goal: Combine concessive futures, *con/para lo que*, evaluative subjunctive and contrast markers
grammar: futuro-concesivo, con-lo-que-para-lo-que, a-pesar-de, concesivas-aun-cuando, subjunctive-value-judgments, contrast-markers

items: I can concede present and past points naturally with the future and conditional before *pero*.
I can evaluate results and benchmarks with *con lo (adj/adv) que* and *para lo (adj/adv) que*.
I can combine *a pesar de*, *aun cuando*, evaluative subjunctive and contrast markers in a balanced judgement.
